description_expanded: Welcome to Just Shellin’ —formerly known as Palm Breezes—a coastal retreat where comfort meets sophistication and every detail is designed for connection, relaxation, and the joy of seaside living. This gracious 30A vacation home enjoys the best of both worlds: just moments from a large public beach access used exclusively by residents and guests of this community—thanks to the absence of public parking, it offers a uniquely serene beach experience. With four beautiful bedrooms, multiple living areas, and thoughtful spaces for gathering—including a king-sized sleeper sofa in the living room that provides additional accommodations—it’s the kind of place where families and friends return year after year to make memories. The main living level exudes warmth and coastal elegance, with rich hardwood floors, soft neutral tones, and abundant natural light pouring through oversized windows. The open-concept layout makes entertaining easy, with a spacious living room anchored by a large sectional and flatscreen TV—perfect for movie nights, lively conversations, or curling up with a good book. Two sets of framed glass doors open to separate balconies, inviting in the breeze and seamlessly extending the living space outdoors. Nearby, a stunning hardwood dining table seats twelve, with four additional barstools at the granite-topped kitchen island. The kitchen is a chef’s dream, complete with a built-in oven and microwave, gas cooktop, stainless steel appliances, and generous counter space for both meal prep and grazing. Two serene primary suites offer private escapes, each with a king-size bed, cozy sitting area, and spa-inspired ensuite bath. One features a soaking tub and separate walk-in shower, while the other includes dual vanities and a sunlit corner workspace—ideal for remote work, journaling, or simply savoring a moment of quiet. Two additional guest rooms are airy and inviting, each styled with coastal accents and premium linens. Multiple bathrooms, finished with granite and stone, offer a mix of walk-in showers, soaking tubs, and double vanities for added comfort and ease. From top to bottom, the home is filled with elevated extras that make it a cut above—from the convenience of an upper-level laundry, to designer lighting, curated artwork, and timeless furnishings that reflect the spirit of 30A. Multiple balconies and a welcoming front porch offer inviting spaces to sip your morning coffee, unwind with evening cocktails, or simply enjoy the breeze after a day at the beach. Just beyond your front door, the best of 30A is waiting to be discovered. Walk or bike to the nearby beach, where emerald waves and sugar-white sand promise hours of seaside bliss. Browse local shops and galleries at Gulf Place, grab brunch at Stinky’s , or paddle the rare dune lakes nearby. Whether your trip calls for peace and quiet or days packed with adventure, this thoughtfully designed home places you in the heart of it all. Make Just Shellin’ your home base for a memorable 30A beach escape, where modern luxury meets the relaxed vibe of Santa Rosa Beach. Book your stay and start making unforgettable memories today! First Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Walk-In-Shower and Patio Access. Second Floor: Living Room with King Sleeper Sofa and Balcony Access, Full Bathroom, Kitchen, Dining. Third Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Walk-In-Shower and Soaking Tub + Balcony Access, Queen Bedroom with Walk-In-Shower, Queen Bedroom with Shower/Tub Combo.
